name: NXRS
description: A general-purpose Rust firmware framework built on NuttX.
guides: Install tools and run a small Rust program
Prepare a target and build firmware
Choose development commands and Rust component APIs
Connect owners, define delivery and manage lifetimes
Run typed commands, observe completion and join shutdown
Threads, time, collections, files and sockets
Typed commands, event loops and shutdown
Understand planning, Cargo, native preparation and artifacts
Select devices, resources and target settings
Understand results and measure your workload
Learning programs and optional application examples
